Fixes the missing and late **Server started** and **Server stopped** notifications from 1.1.0-beta.1, and adds restart alerts.

Flytower now reads each server's log as Minecraft writes it, with no polling and no mod or plugin needed, so starts, stops, joins and leaves arrive within about a second. **Server started** is sent once players can actually join, and chat or `/say` can't fake any of these events. **Restart** from the panel now sends "Server restarting" and then "Server restarted", instead of a separate stop and start.

Testing notes are in section 1 of [testing-1.1.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.1.0-beta.2/docs/testing-1.1.0.md).
